content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers provide a reliable and affordable solution for digital creators in Nigeria and beyond. By setting up this infrastructure, creators can automate their payment processing pipeline, receive instant notifications of incoming payments, and focus on growing their businesses without the hassle of payment processing. This infrastructure is particularly useful for creators who sell digital products, as it allows them to receive instant payouts and avoid the high fees associated with traditional payment processors. By using NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers, creators can take control of their payment processing and avoid the limitations of platforms like Gumroad and Stripe.
What You Need Before You Deploy

To set up NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers, you will need to create a NOWPayments account, set up a Cloudflare Workers account, and install the NOWPayments worker script. You will also need to configure your payment and delivery pipeline, including setting up your USDT on Tron or Solana wallet and connecting it to your NOWPayments account. Additionally, you will need to install the Supabase database and configure it to store your order data. Finally, you will need to test your infrastructure to ensure that it is working correctly before going live.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you will need to connect your NOWPayments account to your USDT on Tron or Solana wallet, and configure the payment and delivery settings to your liking. You will also need to install the Supabase database and configure it to store your order data. Once you have set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you will need to test it to ensure that it is working correctly before going live. This involves sending a test payment through NOWPayments and verifying that the payment is processed correctly and the order data is stored in Supabase.
NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers provide a reliable and affordable solution for digital creators in Nigeria and beyond.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you have set up your payment and delivery pipeline and tested it, you are ready to go live. To process your first transaction, simply send a payment through NOWPayments and verify that it is processed correctly. You should receive instant notifications of incoming payments and your order data should be stored in Supabase. If everything is working correctly, you can start accepting payments from your customers and focus on growing your business. To ensure that your infrastructure is secure, make sure to configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings on your domain.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is running smoothly, you can start scaling your business. To do this, you will need to upgrade your NOWPayments plan to handle more traffic, and configure your payment and delivery pipeline to handle more orders. You will also need to monitor your infrastructure to ensure that it is working correctly and make any necessary adjustments to optimize performance. Additionally, you can use Edge Commerce Stack ($197) to deploy a fully-fledged e-commerce platform that integrates with your NOWPayments account and Supabase database, allowing you to scale your business to the next level.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

USDT is the most practical starting point for digital product sales because it eliminates price volatility from the equation. Your buyer pays in USDT and you receive USDT — one dollar in equals one dollar received, minus the Tron network fee of under $0.10 per transaction and the NOWPayments fee of 0.5%. You do not need to manage exchange rate risk or time your conversions around market movements. When you are ready to convert to local currency, you use a P2P exchange — Binance P2P operates in most countries where conventional payment platforms are unavailable and supports competitive local currency rates.
USDT on Tron offers a more affordable option, with transaction fees averaging under $0.10 per transaction.

Your Deployment Checklist

To set up NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers, follow these steps: Create a NOWPayments account and set up a Cloudflare Workers account. Install the NOWPayments worker script and configure your payment and delivery pipeline. Connect your USDT on Tron or Solana wallet to your NOWPayments account and install the Supabase database. Configure SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings on your domain and test your infrastructure to ensure that it is working correctly before going live.

The cost of using NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers is minimal, with transaction fees averaging under $0.10 per transaction for USDT on Tron and fractions of a cent per transaction for Solana. Additionally, you will need to pay a small fee for the NOWPayments worker script and any additional services you may need.
How do I monitor my infrastructure to ensure that it is working correctly?

To monitor your infrastructure, you will need to set up logging and monitoring tools to track any errors or issues that may arise. You can also use Cloudflare's built-in monitoring tools to track your Workers and ensure that they are working correctly.
Can I use NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers to sell physical products?

While NOWPayments webhooks with Cloudflare Workers are primarily designed for digital product sales, you can use them to sell physical products by integrating them with a third-party shipping service.

To upgrade your NOWPayments plan, you will need to contact NOWPayments support and let them know that you need to upgrade. They will guide you through the process and ensure that you have the necessary resources to handle more traffic.
